name: The Pampas War
description: A raider faction in the Pampas has gotten their hands on pre-war military hardware from a crashed aircraft. El Gaucho has been watching them gather strength for six months. Time to act before they hit the first settlement.

stages.name: Travel to the Pampas
stages.description: Leave Buenos Aires and head west into the Pampas grasslands. El Gaucho's informants have tracked the raider faction to a fortified position near the old crash site.

stages.name: Locate the Raider Camp
stages.description: Find the raider faction's fortified camp. El Gaucho warns they have more hardware than a normal raider band — approach with intelligence before commitment.

stages.name: Neutralize the Threat
stages.description: Stop the raider faction before they move on the first settlement. El Gaucho prefers the hardware be destroyed or secured — he'll accept whatever outcome prevents the attack.
